entities.summary: Seyed Ali Mousavi Noor (b. 2006-03-07, Ramhormoz) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ramhormoz and Iran. Known in the fields of iran, architects & designers, asia.
